text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're tracking increased errors from the EU inference region. Ops is on it but marketing needs customer-facing wording + timing. Sam, can you confirm blast radius and ETA? cc @ryan-sales @jenna-cs

sam-oncall: elevated 5xx and latency in eu-1 since ~10:12 UTC. Rolling restart started. No evidence of data loss. Estimated mitigation 15–30m.

ryan-sales: We need a concise line for account teams and a slightly longer status page blurb. Account teams want a one-liner they can paste into CRM notes.

maya: Draft status page blurb (please critique — want minimal jargon):
```
Status: Degraded performance in EU inference region
Impact: Some text generation and embedding requests may fail or experience high latency for customers routed to eu-1.
Mitigation: Engineers are performing a rolling restart; requests may be routed to alternate regions where applicable.
Next update: in 30 minutes
```

jenna-cs: Recommend soften "fail" -> "may be delayed or return errors" and add CTA for Dedicated/private customers to open a ticket for priority routing.

sam-oncall: agree with wording tweak. Also add: "No customer data exposure detected."

leo-prod: Suggest we avoid implying auto-routing for all customers — clarify "where supported by customer configuration" or give explicit retry guidance. e.g., add: "If possible, retry after 10s or set region override to a non-EU region."

emma-bizops: Timing recs from biz ops: publish status page now (as soon as wording finalized), targeted email to Dedicated/Private customers within 1 hour, and a broader emailed note + blog follow-up after incident is closed with root cause. No external benchmark/marketing comms until postmortem.

maya: Proposed final short copy for account teams (one-liner):
"We're seeing degraded performance in the EU inference region; our engineers are mitigating the issue — ETA ~30m. For priority support, open a support ticket and mention \"EU inference errors.\""

ryan-sales: Good. I'll surface that to key accounts. Jenna — can you prepare the support email template?

jenna-cs: On it. Drafted template below — feedback?
```
Subject: Update: Degraded performance in EU inference region
Hi {{first_name}},
We wanted to let you know we're seeing degraded performance for inference requests routed to our EU region. Our team is actively mitigating; ETA ~30m. If you need priority assistance or a temporary routing change, reply to this message or open a ticket and reference "EU inference errors."
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

sam-oncall: Incident logged as INC-2026-042 by incident-bot. Root cause investigation in progress.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created — severity: high — assigned: sam-oncall.

maya: Final checklist before publish: (1) agree on final status page copy, (2) ops confirms next update time, (3) support template ready, (4) email list for Dedicated/Private. Can everyone drop an emoji when done? :pray:

jenna-cs: ✅ support template ready.
ryan-sales: ✅ told key AMs, they want the one-liner.
leo-prod: ✅ wording tweak approved (added retry guidance).

emma-bizops: ✅ email list for Dedicated/Private ready.

sam-oncall: ✅ will post 30-min update or earlier if resolved.

maya: I'll publish the status page copy in ~5m and kick the targeted mail. Thanks all — we'll reconvene if scope changes. :thumbsup:
